---
title: "Module 1: Master Metadata Construction"
author: "Helen Hoxie"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Build synchronized metadata tables:

1. `master_patient`: one row per OCSCC patient, combining clinical variables, HPV
   status, mutation burden and per-gene mutation flags.
2. `master_samples`: one row per mRNA barcode (tumor and normal adjacent tissue,
   NAT), aligned to count-matrix columns for differential expression and WGCNA.
3. `mirna_sample_map`: the equivalent table for miRNA barcodes.

Only primary tumor (sample type `01`) and NAT (`11`) samples are retained.
Tumor-intrinsic attributes (somatic mutation flags, mutation burden, HPV status)
are defined for tumor samples only and are `NA` for NAT samples. Mutation flags
and burden count non-synonymous variants only (`config.json: mutations`).
Patients without mutation data have `NA` flags and burden, not `FALSE`/`0`.

**Inputs** (relative to `project_dir`): `data/processed/clinical_ocscc.rds`,
`rna_metadata_ocscc.rds`, `mirna_metadata_ocscc.rds`, `OCSCC_Mutation_Details.txt`
(Module 0); `data/external/HPV_summary_TCGA2015NatureSupp1_2.txt`.

**Outputs:**

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/processed/master_patient.rds` | patient-level metadata |
| `data/processed/master_samples.rds` | sample-level metadata, mRNA barcodes |
| `data/processed/mirna_sample_map.rds` | sample-level metadata, miRNA barcodes |


```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
start_log(cfg, "Module_1_Metadata")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

flag_genes    <- cfg$mutations$flag_genes
nonsyn_classes <- cfg$mutations$nonsynonymous_classes
retained_sample_types <- c(Tumor = "01", Normal = "11")

cat("Mutation flag genes:", paste(flag_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Non-synonymous classes:", paste(nonsyn_classes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```


## 1. Patient-level metadata

```{r patient_metadata}
clinical_ocscc <- readRDS(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "clinical_ocscc.rds"))

hpv_data <- read.table(proj_path(cfg, "data", "external", "HPV_summary_TCGA2015NatureSupp1_2.txt"),
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, Final_HPV_Status)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hpv_data$patient_id))

maf_all <- read.table(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "OCSCC_Mutation_Details.txt"),
                      header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      quote = "", comment.char = "") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient_id       = substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12),
                sample_type_code = substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 14, 15))

# Mutation calls from primary tumors only (same sample-type rule as the RNA tables)
excluded_maf <- maf_all %>% dplyr::filter(sample_type_code != retained_sample_types[["Tumor"]])
cat("Excluded MAF tumor barcodes (sample type not 01):\n")
print(dplyr::count(excluded_maf, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, name = "n_variants"), row.names = FALSE)

maf_details <- maf_all %>% dplyr::filter(sample_type_code == retained_sample_types[["Tumor"]])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(unique(maf_details[, c("patient_id", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode")])$patient_id))

# A patient has mutation data if any variant of any class was called
patients_with_maf <- unique(maf_details$patient_id)

maf_nonsyn <- maf_details %>% dplyr::filter(Variant_Classification %in% nonsyn_classes)

cat("Variants in MAF (all tumor barcodes):", nrow(maf_all), "\n")
cat("Variants from primary tumors:", nrow(maf_details), "\n")
cat("Non-synonymous variants retained:", nrow(maf_nonsyn), "\n")
cat("Patients with mutation data:", length(patients_with_maf), "\n")

# Non-synonymous mutation burden and LoF genes per patient
patient_mut_summary <- maf_nonsyn %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mutation_Burden = dplyr::n(),
    LoF_Genes = paste(unique(Hugo_Symbol[Mutation_Type == "LoF"]), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Per-gene flags: TRUE if the patient carries >= 1 non-synonymous variant in the gene
driver_status <- maf_nonsyn %>%
  dplyr::filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% flag_genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id, Hugo_Symbol) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mutated = TRUE) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Hugo_Symbol, values_from = mutated, values_fill = FALSE)
for (g in setdiff(flag_genes, colnames(driver_status))) driver_status[[g]] <- FALSE
driver_status <- driver_status %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_mutant"), .cols = dplyr::all_of(flag_genes))

master_patient <- clinical_ocscc %>%
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = submitter_id) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hpv_data, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Has_Mutation_Data = patient_id %in% patients_with_maf) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(patient_mut_summary, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(driver_status, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Absence of a variant means wild-type only for patients with mutation data
  dplyr::mutate(
    Mutation_Burden = ifelse(Has_Mutation_Data, tidyr::replace_na(Mutation_Burden, 0L), NA_integer_),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::ends_with("_mutant"),
                  ~ ifelse(Has_Mutation_Data, tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE), NA))
  ) %>%
  # Collapse IVA/IVB/IVC into Stage IV; unstaged stays NA
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stage_Grouped = dplyr::case_when(
      ajcc_pathologic_stage == "Stage I"       ~ "Stage I",
      ajcc_pathologic_stage == "Stage II"      ~ "Stage II",
      ajcc_pathologic_stage == "Stage III"     ~ "Stage III",
      grepl("^Stage IV", ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Stage IV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

stopifnot(nrow(master_patient) == nrow(clinical_ocscc))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(master_patient$patient_id))

cat("=== Patient-Level Metadata ===\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(master_patient), "\n")
cat("With mutation data:", sum(master_patient$Has_Mutation_Data), "\n")
cat("\nHPV status:\n")
print(table(master_patient$Final_HPV_Status, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nMutation flags (TRUE / FALSE / NA):\n")
for (g in paste0(flag_genes, "_mutant")) {
  x <- master_patient[[g]]
  cat(sprintf("  %-14s %4d / %4d / %4d\n", g,
              sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!x, na.rm = TRUE), sum(is.na(x))))
}
cat("\nStage distribution:\n")
print(table(master_patient$Stage_Grouped, useNA = "ifany"))

saveRDS(master_patient, proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "master_patient.rds"))
```


## 2. Sample-level metadata (mRNA)

```{r sample_metadata}
rna_meta <- readRDS(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "rna_metadata_ocscc.rds"))

tumor_intrinsic_cols <- c("Final_HPV_Status", "Mutation_Burden", "LoF_Genes",
                          paste0(flag_genes, "_mutant"))

excluded_rna <- rna_meta %>% dplyr::filter(!sample_type_code %in% retained_sample_types)
cat("Excluded mRNA samples (sample type not 01/11):", nrow(excluded_rna), "\n")
if (nrow(excluded_rna) > 0) print(excluded_rna[, c("barcode", "sample_type_code")], row.names = FALSE)

master_samples <- rna_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, patient_id, sample_type_code) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_type_code %in% retained_sample_types) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_group = names(retained_sample_types)[match(sample_type_code, retained_sample_types)]) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(master_patient, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(tumor_intrinsic_cols), ~ replace(.x, sample_group != "Tumor", NA)),
    Stage_NEL = dplyr::case_when(
      sample_group == "Normal"                          ~ "Normal",
      Stage_Grouped %in% c("Stage I", "Stage II")       ~ "Early Stage",
      Stage_Grouped %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IV")     ~ "Late Stage",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# No row inflation from the patient join
stopifnot(nrow(master_samples) == nrow(rna_meta) - nrow(excluded_rna))

cat("=== Sample-Level Metadata (mRNA) ===\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(master_samples), "\n")
print(table(master_samples$sample_group))
cat("\nNormal / Early / Late:\n")
print(table(master_samples$Stage_NEL, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nHPV status by sample group:\n")
print(table(master_samples$sample_group, master_samples$Final_HPV_Status, useNA = "ifany"))

saveRDS(master_samples, proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "master_samples.rds"))
```


## 3. Sample-level metadata (miRNA)

```{r mirna_sample_map}
mirna_meta <- readRDS(proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "mirna_metadata_ocscc.rds"))

excluded_mirna <- mirna_meta %>% dplyr::filter(!sample_type_code %in% retained_sample_types)
cat("Excluded miRNA samples (sample type not 01/11):", nrow(excluded_mirna), "\n")
if (nrow(excluded_mirna) > 0) print(excluded_mirna[, c("barcode", "sample_type_code")], row.names = FALSE)

mirna_sample_map <- mirna_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, patient_id, sample_type_code) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_type_code %in% retained_sample_types) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_group = names(retained_sample_types)[match(sample_type_code, retained_sample_types)]) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(master_patient %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, Final_HPV_Status, Stage_Grouped),
                   by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Final_HPV_Status = replace(Final_HPV_Status, sample_group != "Tumor", NA))

stopifnot(nrow(mirna_sample_map) == nrow(mirna_meta) - nrow(excluded_mirna))

cat("=== Sample-Level Metadata (miRNA) ===\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(mirna_sample_map), "\n")
print(table(mirna_sample_map$sample_group))

saveRDS(mirna_sample_map, proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", "mirna_sample_map.rds"))
```


```{r cleanup_and_session_info}
rm(clinical_ocscc, hpv_data, maf_all, excluded_maf, maf_details, maf_nonsyn, patient_mut_summary, driver_status,
   rna_meta, mirna_meta, excluded_rna, excluded_mirna)
invisible(gc())
stop_log()
```
